resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county survey describes a 94-foot ladder tower, while its 1960 survey notes give an overall height of 100 feet. The facts use 94 ft (28.7 m), the tower height in the county description; the 100 ft overall figure is kept in the 1960 event note.
The Central US Lookouts page spells the county 'Aitken'; the Wikimedia survey and the record use Aitkin, which is used here.

sources.title: Aitkin County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Height conflict (94 ft tower vs 100 ft overall in 1960 notes) is unresolved; facts use 94 ft. Newest on-site description is 1960; the Aitkin PDF has no date for its status, and the FFLA list has none either, so current condition and public access are unverified and no access key was set. The Commons photo already in the record was not re-added. No NHLR or FFLOS registration was found. The statewide A-Z list (upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/9f/A-Z_List-Towers.pdf) has the same 1933 and 94 ft figures but was not cited.
